relations.description: When UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access and receives paging with non-3GPP access type, UE shall not respond
When UE-initiated procedure is ongoing and paging is received, UE shall proceed with the procedure
If access attempt is barred, UE shall handle pending paging message as specified in subclause 5.6.2.2.1
Once lower layers confirm establishment of signalling connection, UE shall ignore the paging
